privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: How Decker Pex Levi collects, uses, holds and protects personal information · Last updated September 2026
privacy.lede: This document sets out the privacy policy of Decker Pex Levi, Advocates and Notaries, and explains how we collect, use, hold and protect the personal information of website users, clients, suppliers and anyone else who is in contact with us. The firm attaches great importance to protecting your privacy and acts in accordance with the Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981, Amendment 13 to that law, and the regulations made under it. By using the website https://lawoffice.org.il, or by contacting the firm in any other way (telephone, email, forms, mailing list, meeting and so on), you signify your agreement to this policy.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
paras: We collect only what the matter requires.
bullets: Identifying details: full name and identity or passport number
Contact details: telephone, email address, postal address
Information about your use of the site: pages viewed, actions taken, time on page, referrals
Technical information: IP address, device and browser type, operating system, internet provider
Any further detail you choose to give us on your own initiative, for example in a message or enquiry
Statistical or aggregated information that does not identify a person is not treated as personal information

sections.title: 2. How the information is collected
bullets: Information you give us on your own initiative
Information collected automatically through cookies, pixels, logs and similar technologies
Information received from third parties such as a payment processor, a CRM provider, mailing systems, Google Analytics and Meta Ads

sections.title: 3. Purposes of use
paras: The firm uses the information in order to:
bullets: Provide legal services to clients
Manage client relations and new enquiries
Send professional updates, notices and marketing content, only with consent and with removal available at any time
Operate, maintain and improve the website and the services
Comply with legal obligations that apply to the firm, including the rules of the Israel Bar Association, file management and required reporting
Protect the firm's rights, manage disputes and respond to claims
Any other purpose for which explicit consent was given

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
paras: Processing rests on one or more of the following: your explicit consent; a legal obligation that applies to the firm, such as retaining documents under the ethics rules; or a legitimate interest of the firm, such as providing the service, managing files, improving service, or legal defence.
You may withdraw your consent at any time, subject to law.

sections.title: 5. Disclosure to third parties
paras: Where necessary, the firm may use external service providers to deliver legal services and for day-to-day operations. Where payment is made through the site, it is processed by an external, secure payment provider that meets information-security standards (PCI DSS); card details are entered directly with that provider and are not stored by the firm.
The firm may disclose personal information to:
bullets: Service providers acting on its behalf (payment processing, CRM, cloud storage, mailing services and the like)
Professional advisers such as accountants and external experts, subject to a duty of confidentiality
Enforcement or regulatory authorities, where required by law or under an order
Another body in the event of a structural change, merger or transfer of activity, subject to an undertaking to uphold this policy
sections.tail: The firm will not transfer personal information to third parties for marketing purposes without explicit consent.

sections.title: 6. Transfer outside Israel
paras: Information may be held on cloud servers abroad, for example AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure. Transfers are made only to countries with an adequate level of protection, or subject to binding agreements to protect your privacy.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and tracking technologies
paras: The firm uses cookies to operate the site and to measure and improve its performance, together with analytics tools (Google Analytics 4) and Meta pixels.
You can change your browser settings to restrict cookies, though this may affect your browsing experience. Continued use of the site constitutes consent to this use.

sections.title: 8. Direct marketing
paras: The firm sends content and updates only after explicit consent has been given, or in accordance with the exceptions in section 30A of the Communications Law. Every message carries a link for immediate removal.

sections.title: 9. Retention and security
paras: Information is kept for the periods required for the purposes for which it was collected, and in accordance with legal obligations and the rules of the Israel Bar Association. Client files, for example, are retained for the periods required by law or by the ethics rules.

On completion of the matter, or at your request, information is deleted or anonymised, subject to legal retention duties. The firm applies advanced information-security measures: encryption, access control, security audits, and confidentiality undertakings with its employees and suppliers.

sections.title: 10. Minors
paras: The legal services and this website are not intended for minors under the age of 18. If the firm learns that information about a minor was collected without the consent of a parent or guardian, that information will be deleted.

sections.title: 11. Your rights as a data subject
paras: Under the Protection of Privacy Law you may:
bullets: Inspect information held about you
Request its correction or deletion
Object to the processing of information
Request that information be transferred to another body, so far as is technically possible
sections.tail: A request to exercise these rights should be made in writing, together with a means of identification.

sections.title: 12. Data Protection Officer
paras: The firm has appointed a Data Protection Officer in accordance with Amendment 13. For privacy matters: telephone 055-978-1688, email office@lawoffice.org.il.

sections.title: 13. Not legal advice
paras: We wish to caution visitors that the information on this website is not a substitute for professional legal advice from an attorney. The material presented is a basic survey only of the laws, regulations, procedures and court rulings relating to the legal subjects reviewed. We cannot give a comprehensive answer on every legal field presented. Attorneys and jurists also differ at times in their views on the interpretation of the law and of court rulings. Moreover, the legal position is dynamic, and it is possible that information presented on the website is no longer current. Accordingly, if you are seeking legal advice on a specific question, we suggest that you contact us directly. We will be glad to be of service and to assist you as far as we are able with any legal question. Information on this site written in the masculine form is for convenience only and is intended for women and men alike.

sections.title: 14. Changes to this policy
paras: The firm may update this privacy policy from time to time. An updated version, carrying its update date, is published on this site, and continued use of the site after an update constitutes agreement to the updated policy.

sections.title: 15. Contact
paras: For any question about privacy: telephone 055-978-1688, email office@lawoffice.org.il, or write to 11 Menachem Begin Road, Rogovin Tidhar Tower, floor 25, Ramat Gan.

sections.title: Contacting us does not create a lawyer-client relationship
paras: Sending an enquiry through a form on this site, through the chat, through the eligibility check, or by telephone does not create a lawyer-client relationship. That relationship begins only when the firm accepts your case and an engagement is agreed in writing.
Until then, please do not send confidential or privileged material through this site.

sections.title: No outcome is guaranteed
paras: Eligibility for citizenship, for a visa or for status in Israel depends on the records and facts of each case, and on decisions of authorities the firm does not control. We assess cases candidly and undertake only those with a reasonable prospect of success. We do not guarantee eligibility, approval or any timetable.
Where a page of this site gives an indication of eligibility, it is an indication based on the answers you gave and nothing more.

sections.title: Fees and third-party costs
paras: The professional fee is quoted after an attorney has read your case, and you see it before any work begins. Third-party costs, such as archive searches, certified translations, apostilles and consular or authority fees, are charged at cost and listed for you in advance.

sections.title: The client area
paras: Where you hold an account in the client portal, you are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for the accuracy of the information you enter. Please tell us at once if you believe your account has been used by someone else.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paras: The texts, design, graphics, logos and articles on this site belong to Decker Pex Levi or are used with permission. They may be read and quoted with attribution, but may not be copied, republished or used commercially without the firm's written consent.

sections.title: Links to other sites
paras: This site may link to pages operated by others, including authorities and archives. The firm does not control those pages and is not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paras: The site is provided as is. The firm is not liable for damage arising from reliance on information published here, from a technical fault, or from the unavailability of the site.

sections.title: Applicable law and jurisdiction
paras: These terms, and any matter arising from the use of this website, are governed by the law of the State of Israel. The competent courts in Tel Aviv have exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paras: The firm may update these terms from time to time. The current version is published here with its update date, and continued use of the site after an update signifies agreement to it.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.updated: Prepared in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Service Accessibility Adjustments), 5773-2013 · Last updated September 2026
accessibility.lede: Decker Pex Levi regards access to its services, and to this website, as a right rather than a courtesy, and works to make both usable by people with disabilities.

sections.title: What this site provides
paras: The site was built to be operable by keyboard alone, to keep a visible focus indicator on every interactive element, to use text contrast at or above the accepted ratios, and to carry text alternatives for meaningful images.
An accessibility panel is available from the button at the lower left of every page. It offers:
bullets: Larger and smaller text
High contrast and inverted colours
Grayscale and a lightened background
Underlined links
A readable sans-serif font
Stopping animation and motion

sections.title: Your choices are remembered
paras: Settings you choose in the accessibility panel are stored on your own device and reapplied on your next visit. They can be cleared at any time with Reset all.

sections.title: Accessibility at our offices
paras: Both offices are reached by lift and their meeting rooms are accessible to wheelchair users. Consultations can be held in Hebrew, English, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, German, Dutch or Spanish, and by telephone or video where attendance in person is difficult.
If you need a specific adjustment in order to meet us, please say so when you make the appointment and we will arrange it.

sections.title: Known limitations
paras: Some third-party content embedded in this site, such as video players and the scheduling calendar, is supplied by others and its accessibility is not under the firm's control. Where such content blocks you, please contact us and we will provide the same information or service by another route.

sections.title: Accessibility coordinator and feedback
paras: If you encounter an accessibility problem on this site, or need an adjustment to receive a service, please contact us. We will answer and, where we can, correct the matter.
Telephone 055-978-1688 · office@lawoffice.org.il · 11 Menachem Begin Road, Ramat Gan
